runProtocol: Select fixed source proof and pinned native command manifest; validate role and actual native selectors before mutable runtime exists.
Hold preparation lease; verify physical capture, private hardlink closure, source/projected hashes, aliases, directory inventories, tools and outputs do not overlap.
Build effective namespace and exact cleared environment; create fresh role/run HOME, scratch, output inodes and controlled recorder channels.
At empirically verified pre-exec barrier inspect actual mount namespace, child root and inode identities; no unproved mount plan receipts.
Start exact pinned executable/argv/cwd with no inherited readable source FDs except explicitly bound controller transport; trace full descendants.
Authenticate every event against source/tool bindings, finite lookup family, explicit runtime observations or run output/scratch provenance; record complete read/discovery/write/process coverage.
Wait for actual complete process tree and all writers to exit; reject unexpected exec, namespace change, socket/IPC ingress, source writes or unsupported operations.
Recheck input bytes, inodes, aliases, membership and lock; seal fresh outputs after quiescence; run readers in separate fully authenticated context when possible.
Only then evaluate unchanged native semantic checks and publish role/producer-specific result; source proof, namespace pass, read pass and semantic pass remain separate.
